notes: Notes page puts the slide next to a large script editor, which is where you write what you will actually say. These notes belong to the Main Slide, so they come along wherever the slide is reused. When one talk needs a different explanation, for example a shorter version for a general audience, that Presentation can attach its own notes to that appearance of the slide without touching the Main notes. The notes you are hearing now were written that way.

designIntent.purpose: Show Main speaker notes and occurrence-specific notes.
